documents.orbit-handbook.md:
# Installation
Install Orbit on macOS with `brew install orbit`. On Linux download the tarball from the releases page.

# Configuration
Orbit listens on port 8080 by default. Change it with the --port flag.

# Backups
Backups run every night at 02:00 and are kept for 14 days.

# Support
Contact the support team through the help desk portal during business hours.
